name: Noheji (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Noheji town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised spiral.
history: Municipal flag of Noheji, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 November 1961.

features.role: Noheji town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised spiral
